Observation: Default vendor passwords found active on two SCADA HMI workstations.
Audit Recommendation: Change all default credentials and enforce password policy on HMIs.
Corrective Action: Reset default passwords; implement password vault.
Action Taken: Passwords changed on HMI-1; HMI-2 pending OEM visit.

Observation: SCADA network is not segmented from the corporate LAN; flat network observed.
Audit Recommendation: Implement zones and conduits with an industrial firewall between OT and IT.
Corrective Action: Procure industrial firewall and redesign network.
Action Taken: Purchase requisition raised; tender in progress.

Observation: RTU firmware is outdated and has known vulnerabilities.
Audit Recommendation: Upgrade RTU firmware to the latest supported version.

Observation: USB ports on engineering workstations are not disabled.
Audit Recommendation: Disable USB mass storage via policy; allow only whitelisted devices.
Corrective Action: Apply USB lock policy through endpoint tool.

Observation: Remote access to LDS server through third-party tool without MFA.
Audit Recommendation: Remove unmanaged remote tools; provide VPN with multi-factor authentication.
Corrective Action: Remove remote tool; configure secure VPN with MFA.
Action Taken: Remote tool removed; VPN with MFA configured.

Observation: Historian server logs are not forwarded to a central log server.
Audit Recommendation: Forward security logs to central log server / SIEM.

Observation: Antivirus signatures on SCADA servers not updated for more than 90 days.
Audit Recommendation: Implement offline signature update procedure for OT antivirus.

Observation: PLC programming laptops are shared and lack asset tagging.
Audit Recommendation: Maintain asset register and assign laptops to named users.
Corrective Action: Update asset register; issue named laptops.

Observation: Firewall rule base contains "any-any" rules not reviewed since commissioning.
Audit Recommendation: Review firewall rules quarterly; remove unused and permissive rules.

Observation: Dormant user accounts (>90 days) remain enabled in Active Directory.
Audit Recommendation: Disable dormant accounts and run monthly access review.
Action Taken: Dormant accounts disabled; review process started.

Observation: Backups of critical servers are not tested for restoration.
Audit Recommendation: Perform and document quarterly restoration tests.
Action Taken: First restoration test done in Sep 2026.

Observation: Visitor register for control room not maintained consistently.
Audit Recommendation: Maintain visitor log and restrict access by card.
Corrective Action: Introduce visitor register and access card review.

Observation: Phishing awareness training not conducted in the last year.
Audit Recommendation: Conduct annual cyber awareness and phishing simulation.

Observation: Wi-Fi access point at terminal uses WPA2-Personal with shared key.
Audit Recommendation: Move to WPA2/3-Enterprise with individual authentication.

Observation: Incident response plan does not cover OT incidents.
Audit Recommendation: Update incident response plan to include OT scenarios and drills.
Corrective Action: Revise IR plan with OT annexure.

Observation: Server room access log shows tailgating; no CCTV coverage at door.
Audit Recommendation: Install CCTV and enforce single-person entry.

Observation: SQL injection vulnerability in vendor portal login page.
Audit Recommendation: Fix input validation and use parameterised queries.

Observation: TLS 1.0 enabled on public-facing web server.
Audit Recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1; allow TLS 1.2+ only.

Observation: Outdated Java runtime on ERP application servers.
Audit Recommendation: Upgrade runtime to supported version.

Observation: SNMP v1 with default community string enabled on core switch.
Audit Recommendation: Disable SNMP v1/v2; use SNMP v3 with authentication.

Observation: SPF/DMARC records not configured for mail domain.
Audit Recommendation: Configure SPF, DKIM and DMARC.

Observation: Database listener accessible from user VLAN.
Audit Recommendation: Restrict database access to application servers only.

Observation: Unused open ports (FTP, Telnet) on file server.
Audit Recommendation: Close unused ports and disable insecure services.

Observation: Patch compliance for desktops below 80%.
Audit Recommendation: Implement centralised patch management with monthly reporting.

Observation: No documented change management for SCADA configuration changes.
Audit Recommendation: Introduce change request and approval procedure for OT changes.
Corrective Action: Draft SOP for OT change management.

Observation: Business continuity plan not tested.
Audit Recommendation: Conduct annual BCP / DR drill.
Remarks: On hold pending DR site readiness.

Observation: UPS for server room has no maintenance contract.
Audit Recommendation: Arrange AMC for server room UPS.

Observation: Network diagram not up to date.
Audit Recommendation: Update network diagram after every change.

Observation: RTU web interface accessible over HTTP without authentication.
Audit Recommendation: Disable web interface or enable HTTPS with authentication.

Observation: PLC program change not password protected.
Audit Recommendation: Enable PLC program protection password.

Observation: Time synchronisation not configured on RTUs (logs unreliable).
Audit Recommendation: Configure NTP from secure time source.

Observation: Vendor maintains permanent remote connectivity to PLC network.
Audit Recommendation: Allow vendor access only on request through monitored jump server.

Observation: Unused accounts present on SCADA servers.
Audit Recommendation: Remove unused accounts; review quarterly.

Observation: SCADA servers do not have a tested backup image.
Audit Recommendation: Create golden images and test restoration.

Observation: No asset inventory of OT devices with firmware versions.
Audit Recommendation: Maintain OT asset inventory including firmware details.

Observation: Session cookies lack Secure and HttpOnly flags.
Audit Recommendation: Set Secure and HttpOnly flags on cookies.

Observation: Local administrator rights granted to all users at station.
Audit Recommendation: Remove local admin rights; use privileged access process.

Observation: SIEM not integrated with terminal firewalls.
Audit Recommendation: Integrate firewall logs with SIEM.

Observation: Mail server banner discloses software version.
Audit Recommendation: Suppress version banner.

Observation: Engineering workstation used for internet browsing.
Audit Recommendation: Block internet access from OT workstations.

Observation: Information security policy not reviewed for 3 years.
Audit Recommendation: Review and approve IS policy.

Observation: PLC communication uses unencrypted Modbus/TCP across WAN.
Audit Recommendation: Use encrypted tunnels for inter-site OT traffic.
Remarks: Severity to be confirmed by auditor.
